13. INSPECT 6TH GEAR RADIAL CLEARANCE
s Using a dial indicator, measure the radial clearance.
j Standard clearance:
0.009 - 0.050 mm (0.0003 - 0.0020 in.)
Maximum clearance:
0.050 mm (0.0020 in.)
If the clearance exceeds the maximum, replace the gear,
needle roller bearing or shaft.
